noloadingscreen.options.title: NoLoadingScreen Settings
noloadingscreen.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn the mod on or off.
noloadingscreen.option.allowMovementWhil: Walk, sprint and jump locally while loading. Keeps your game mode and flight permissions; no changes reach the server.
noloadingscreen.option.loadingOverlay.to: Keep vanilla loading text and the progress bar, without the chunk map.
noloadingscreen.option.allowFlightAndNoc: Always enable flight when entering the placeholder world. While flying with this option enabled, you can pass through walls and see beyond them.
noloadingscreen.option.retainWorldOnKick: Keep the current world after being kicked from a multiplayer server.
noloadingscreen.option.multiplayerWait.t: Maximum waiting time when joining a server.
noloadingscreen.message.spectatorTarget: Spectator mode can teleport only to players loaded in the placeholder world.
noloadingscreen.phase.waitingWorld: Waiting for the server to send the world…
noloadingscreen.message.chatBlocked: You cannot send chat messages right now!
noloadingscreen.message.commandBlocked: You cannot execute commands right now!
